class.name: FmodSettings
class.description: The settings [method FmodServer.init] starts FMOD with. Without settings, [method FmodServer.init] reads them from Project Settings, under [code]Fmod/[/code], in the same groups as the properties below. A new [FmodSettings] holds the defaults of the platform the game runs on, which differ for [member channel_count], [member dsp_buffer_size], [member dsp_buffer_count] and [member live_update]: [codeblock lang=text] Desktop Mobile Web Web (threads) channel_count 1024 512 512 512 dsp_buffer_size 512 1024 2048 1024 dsp_buffer_count 4 4 2 4 live_update on on off off [/codeblock]

members.member: The folder holding the project's banks, which the editor loads for the FMOD explorer and the event pickers.
The most sounds FMOD tracks at once. Only the most audible ones are mixed.
The number of game units in one meter. In 2D, game units are pixels: set it to the number of pixels in one meter of your world.
Scales the pitch change of moving sounds.
How many blocks of sound FMOD keeps ready. More is steadier, fewer is quicker.
The size of the blocks FMOD mixes, in samples. Larger is steadier, smaller is quicker.
The Godot audio bus FMOD's sound plays on, with [constant GODOT_BUS] output.
When FMOD mixes its sound for the Godot bus.
The number of listeners FMOD starts with, from 1 to 8.
If [code]true[/code], FMOD Studio can connect to the running game to edit and profile its sound. Never in the editor, and not available on the web.
If [code]true[/code], FMOD nodes find their events and parameters by path and name instead of by GUID and ID.
The file FMOD logs to, with [constant LOG_OUTPUT_FILE].
How much FMOD logs.
Where FMOD logs.
If [code]true[/code], FMOD reports its memory use to FMOD Studio's profiler, at a small cost.
Where FMOD's sound goes.
The FMOD plugins loaded once FMOD has started.
The number of speakers of the [constant RAW] speaker mode.
Scales how fast sounds fade with distance.
The sample rate FMOD mixes at, in Hz.
The speaker layout FMOD mixes for.
If [code]true[/code], with [constant GODOT_BUS] output, FMOD mixes at Godot's mix rate instead of [member sample_rate], so Godot does not convert FMOD's sound.

constants.constant: The layout of the output device.
[member raw_speaker_count] speakers, with no panning between them.
Front pair, center, and back pair.
Straight to the audio device. The only choice on the web.
Onto a Godot audio bus: its effects and volume, Mute Game and Movie Maker then apply to FMOD. Not on the web.
Ahead of time: protects against crackles, but delays the sound by the whole of FMOD's buffers, [member dsp_buffer_size] times [member dsp_buffer_count].
When Godot asks: delays the sound by at most one block of [member dsp_buffer_size], and is the one for Movie Maker. A very heavy FMOD scene can crackle.
Errors and warnings, and everything when Godot runs with [code]--verbose[/code].
